notes.title: WAIDH v.0.164 - Caving and Underground Update
notes.notes:
WAIDH v.0.164 (14524502) - Tuesday, 28/05/2024 ~22:08 GMT

Changes in this version:
- Added a new item called Empty Glass Jar.
- Added a new item called Glowing Glass Jar.
- Added a new random generating map element called Glow Bug spawner.
Glow Bug spawner only active at night time, which is between 18:00 and 06:00.
- Added new random generating Quests for Merchant AI NPCs at Trading Posts.
- Added new possible goods to purchase from Merchant AI NPCs at Trading Posts.
- Fixed collision check for rain drops - no more raining inside buildings or under trees.
- Added Auto Save option in Settings menu at Gameplay category.
- Fixed Mouse settings in Settings menu at Controls category.
- Added the random generating Cave spawner.
- Added a new Ammunition for Bows called Poisonous Arrow.
Poisonous Arrow reduces enemy health by 35HP in 20 seconds.
Switch between arrows by opening backpack then press use on the desired arrow.
- Added a new Tool called Headlight.
Headlight can be crafted of a Flashlight and a Rope.
- Added 3 new Creatures as Cave Boss AI NPCs.
- Added a new special item called Artifact of the Shadow.
- Added a new special item called Artifact of the Truth.
- Added a new special item called Artifact of the Fear.
These Artifacts can be obtained only by defeating then looting Cave Bosses.
- Fixed invisible blocking collision after death for Creatures.
- Added a new Creature called Giant Mosquito.
Giant Mosquito is a friendly creature as long as you don't mess with it.
- Added a new Creature called Cave Bat.
Cave Bat is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Poisoned effect when attacking.
- Added a new Creature called Cave Rat.
Cave Rat is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Poisoned effect when attacking.
- Added a new Creature called Cave Scorpion.
Cave Scorpion is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Crippled effect when attacking.
- Added a new Creature called Cave Spider.
Cave Spider is an aggressive creature and it has a 50% chance to give you Crippled effect when attacking.
- Added a new Special item called Rat Tail.
- Added a new Special item called Scorpion Sting.
- Added a new Special item called Spider Leg.
- Added a new Special item called Bat Wing.
- Fixed a bug where native AI NPCs stuck under the landscape when they are outside of the render distance.
- Fixed native AI NPCs picked a wrong random quest outside of the Trading Posts.
- Improved existing and added extra hit box (headshot detection) for Creatures and native AI NPCs.
- Added a new Weapon called Enchanted Bow.
Enchanted Bow can only be obtained by completing a special quest from the Merchant AI NPCs and then can be purchased from the Merchant AI NPCs at Trust level 100.
Enchanted Bow is more durable than Primitive Bow and arrows shooted by the Enchanted Bow causing 15% more damage on enemies.
- Added the random generating double floors Maze spawner.
- Added a new Structure called Hard Metal Chest.
- Added a new Structure called Wooden Metal Chest.
- Fixed head rotation for player characters when Aiming with a Bow.
- No longer able to shoot an arrow or throw a spear while moving.
- Fixed a possible game crash when loading saved or generating new world tiles.
- Increased the maximum distance from 10.000m to 100.000m for Transmitters.
- Changed the possibility ranges for Random World Tiles for the World Generation.
Important! Because of this update you will need to regenerate your world by typing: regen into the in-game console which can be accessed by Holding Right Shift + Enter!
The regeneration process will destroy everything that has been randomly generated in the world and everything that you've placed or removed in the world!
For more information about World Regeneration please see the 'World Regeneration' channel on the official WAIDH discord server. 

+++ Added 14 new screenshots to the game's Store Page!

+++ Developer's Birthday SALE ( 29% OFF ) between 29th May - 30th May 2024!

Want to know what's next?
Join the WAIDH Official Discord server and check out the channel called "upcoming".
